metadata.title: Generic Uniqueness of Isoperimetric Regions in Arbitrary Dimension
metadata.abstract: Let $M^{n+1}$ be a closed, connected smooth manifold, where $n\geq 1$. For each prescribed volume fraction $s\in(0,1)\setminus\{\frac12\}$, we prove that the isoperimetric region of volume $s \operatorname{Vol}_g(M)$ is unique for a generic set of smooth Riemannian metrics $g$. At half volume, a generic metric has exactly two minimizers, a region $E$ and its complement $E^c$. As consequences, for every $m>0$, uniqueness holds for a generic set of metrics $g$ satisfying $m<\operatorname{Vol}_g(M)$, and it also holds for a generic set of pairs $(g,m)$ with $0<m<\operatorname{Vol}_g(M)$. The proof is variational and requires neither boundary regularity nor nondegeneracy of the constrained Jacobi operator. In particular, the results apply even when isoperimetric boundaries are singular.

analysis.workSummary: 在任意维闭连通流形上，证明给定非半体积分数的等周区域对泛性光滑度量唯一；半体积时恰有互补的两个极小区域。
techniques: 不依赖边界正则性或 Jacobi 非退化的论证
analysis.breakthrough: 使等周唯一性的泛性理论覆盖可能有奇异边界的高维情形。
analysis.limitations: 对每个固定体积分数的泛性不能未经核对变成同一个度量对所有体积同时唯一；半体积必有互补双解。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 文献检索找到 Ebin 的保体积扰动工具及 Sharp 可微性定理，并辅助泛函分析、证明检查和语言改进；原策略始于2023年，作者称独立核验论证。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.20790v1 · PDF第14页，Disclosure of AI tools

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 AI 文献检索找到 Ebin 的保体积扰动工具及 Sharp 可微性定理，并辅助泛函分析、证明检查和语言改进；原策略始于2023年，作者称独立核验论证。

analysis.priorityReason: 等周几何及高维奇点问题高度相关，论证绕开常见正则性障碍。
